- smoke_clip_part — full length 0:05.0–0:12.0; segment inside the range: 0:05.0–0:08.5 (cut off at the range end).

Caveat: the read-only project state reports track_count 0 and an empty tracks list, so the clip details above come from the note's time digest only — I can't cross-check them against live project state.
